statement: The function returns a result r such that len(r) = n and, for every x with 0 <= x < n, len(r[x]) = n; moreover, for every x,y with 0 <= x < n and 0 <= y < n, r[x][y] is the number of indices k with 0 <= k < len(queries) for which queries[k][0] <= x <= queries[k][2] and queries[k][1] <= y <= queries[k][3]. Equivalently, r is exactly the n by n matrix obtained from the all-zero matrix by adding 1, for each k, to every cell in the inclusive rectangle [queries[k][0]..queries[k][2]] times [queries[k][1]..queries[k][3]].
preconditions: n is an integer with 1 <= n <= 500. queries is a slice with 1 <= len(queries) <= 10000. For every k with 0 <= k < len(queries), len(queries[k]) = 4, and if queries[k] = [row1_k, col1_k, row2_k, col2_k], then 0 <= row1_k <= row2_k < n and 0 <= col1_k <= col2_k < n. All coordinates are 0-based row and column indices.
